programs.title: Old Boys
programs.desc: Charming comedy set in an all-boys school in the 80s. An awkward geek gets caught in a love triangle with a teacher's daughter and the school sports star.

programs.title: Twelve O'Clock High
programs.desc: World War II drama starring Gregory Peck as a US general who must treat a demoralised bomber squadron severely to restore discipline. With Oscar-winning support from Dean Jagger.

programs.title: The Black Shield of Falworth
programs.desc: Medieval action-adventure starring Tony Curtis and Janet Leigh. When a peasant discovers his true lineage, he sets out to woo his noble sweetheart and avenge his father's murder.

programs.title: The Undefeated
programs.desc: Civil War-era western starring John Wayne and Rock Hudson. Union and Confederate soldiers reluctantly join forces to fight against Mexican Emperor Maximillian's invasion.
